listing_title: Casa Singola con Giardino a Jesolo Lido — JBC Immobiliare
raw_text: IT EN DE MENU HOME / PROPERTIES / CASA SINGOLA CON GIARDINO A JESOLO LIDO FOR SALE · DETACHED HOUSE Casa Singola con Giardino a Jesolo Lido PIAZZA AURORA · JESOLO · VENEZIA PRICE €550,000 Photos (17) Floor plans (1) 1 / 17 FLOOR AREA 120 m² BEDROOMS 3 BATHROOMS 2 LIFT No ENERGY CLASS E Overview Welcome to your new home in Jesolo Lido! Just a few steps from Piazza Aurora and only 350 meters from the sea, we offer a single house surrounded by approximately 200 square meters of private garden, a space that provides privacy, tranquility, and the opportunity to enjoy summer in total freedom. The property spans about 100 square meters on one level and consists of spacious and well-distributed areas: entrance hall, a bright living room, separate kitchen, storage room, three generously sized double bedrooms—one with an en-suite bathroom featuring a windowed shower—and an additional bathroom with bathtub. Completing the property is a convenient external storage shed. This solution represents an increasingly rare opportunity: an independent house with private garden just minutes away from the beach, ideal as either an exclusive summer residence or as year-round living accommodation. Additionally, the property offers enormous potential for enhancement: thanks to the outdoor spaces it’s possible to create a splendid private pool and transform the property into an elegant contemporary villa in the heart of Jesolo through modern renovation. A solution for those who desire independence, livable outdoor spaces, and a central location without sacrificing privacy.
